item.title: eL Seed
item.description: eL Seed uses complex Arabic calligraphy to spread messages of peace and unity, blending graffiti with traditional calligraphy in a style he calls ‘calligraffiti’.

item.title: Mattar Bin Lahej
item.description: Mattar Bin Lahej is a self-taught Emirati artist, photographer, and sculptor, famous for his ‘Mattar Script’ and large-scale calligraphy sculptures.
